target.title: fix(discord): inherit forum default_auto_archive_duration for thread creation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #103021: Discord forum threads created via the message tool (action=send to a forum parent) ignore the forum's `default_auto_archive_duration`, always landing at Discord's API default of 4320 minutes (3 days). Operators who set a forum's default archive window (e.g. 1 day) to keep the visible thread list readable get threads that silently linger for 3 days instead.

## Why This Change Was Made

The root cause is in `createThreadDiscord` (send.messages.ts). When `autoArchiveMinutes` is not explicitly set (which is the case for implicit forum-parent `action=send`), `auto_archive_duration` is omitted from the REST call body. Discord then applies its API default of 4320.

The fix restructures `createThreadDiscord` to fetch the parent channel object before building the thread payload (this lookup was already happening for channel-type detection). When `autoArchiveMinutes` is not set and the parent is a forum/GuildMedia channel, it reads the channel's `default_auto_archive_duration` and uses it as the archive window, so threads inherit the forum operator's intended archive behavior. Explicit `autoArchiveMinutes` still overrides the forum default.

Note: `action=thread-create` already supports an `autoArchiveMin` parameter, so this fix only affects the implicit thread creation path via `action=send`.

## User Impact

- Forum threads created via `action=send` now inherit the forum's `default_auto_archive_duration` instead of defaulting to 3 days
- Explicit `autoArchiveMin` parameter still overrides the forum default
- No change to `action=thread-create` behavior
- No change to non-forum thread creation

## Evidence

- `extensions/discord/src/send.creates-thread.test.ts` — 30 tests pass
